# Wait

Source: [wiki article 4480](../archive/4480.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Wait](../../api/actions/wait.md).

<a id="wiki-4480-n1"></a>

- Wait's documented minimum is 0.016s at 62.5 ticks/s; durations round upward to tick intervals (0.030→0.032, 0.1→0.112).

<a id="wiki-4480-n2"></a>

- Wait Behavior uses the rule condition list to choose ignore, abort or restart behavior.
